title: Statistical Equilibrium and Maximum Entropy
research_question: Under what constraints, invariant measures and equilibrium policies does the heterogeneous-agent distribution admit a rigorous entropy-based characterization?
feasibility_hypothesis: Conditional: household optimality and competitive clearing alone do not imply Boltzmann-Gibbs or maximum entropy; require derivable invariant or optimization conditions.
mechanisms: Master equations for joint asset and action distributions
Stationary measures, probability currents and detailed balance
Constrained maximum entropy as a candidate representation
Phase diagrams and metastability if justified
state_variables: aggregate prices and any order parameters
required_equations: Stationary distribution operator or master equation
Conditional entropy optimization and Lagrange multipliers
Detailed balance or stationary probability-current identities
comparison_baseline: Direct invariant distribution of verified GE policy functions, with and without reversible dynamics
acceptance_tests: Prove/verify existence of stationary distribution under assumptions
Check whether proposed entropy density is invariant under the actual kernel
Compare moments and tail behavior to direct microsimulation
Provide explicit counterexample if maximum-entropy property fails
Show when detailed balance is not required or not satisfied
stage_gate: Prove a conditional characterization or report an informative failure; do not impose entropy as an equilibrium axiom.

implementation.method: equilibrium solving plus ABM/distribution verification when relevant
implementation.language: Julia proposed; environment and APIs to be verified before implementation
